## Chillscreen: a better deck and a fuller room
- **New tonearm:** S-shaped chrome arm on a gimbal, height ring, anti-skate dial, counterweight with scale, headshell with finger lift, cartridge with stylus, cue lever that tips when the arm lifts, arm rest with clip
- **Turntable with real controls:** power dial, start/stop, 33/45 with lights, strobe light, pop-up target light, pitch fader with range buttons, and a display that shows the tempo of the song
- **Dot visualizer:** a ring of dots around the platter and a dot matrix on the front move with the music
- **Simpler transitions:** 14 calm ones (glide, cut, fade, black, warm light, light-to-dark, focus, zoom, whip, push, flash, light sweep, vignette, drift), the busy ones are gone
- **Transitions on the beat:** new setting under Chillscreen, off by default. The camera then changes shots on the beat
- **Better plants:** detailed leaves with veins and gloss, a monstera, snake plants and a trailing pothos
- **More in the room:** coffee table with dried pampas, bean bag, floor cushions, guitar on a stand, felt wall panels, floating shelf, a wall clock with the real time, pendant lights, a basket with a blanket
- **20 new camera moves:** the deck controls, the dots, the tonearm up close, every new corner, a glide over the rug, a rise from the coffee table to the window, pans along both sides of the room

The room on the website got the same update.

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
